title: Rewards program invitation (sample:   starbucks)
goal: Tell {first_name} about   starbucks Rewards, our free loyalty program for regular customers. Find out what they enjoy most, and if they want to join, send them the sign-up link that fits their interest by text or email.
opening_line: Hi, this is Maya calling from   starbucks Coffee Co. Am I speaking with {first_name}?
voicemail_message: Hi {first_name}, this is Maya, an   from   starbucks Coffee Co. We have a free rewards program for regulars like you. Ask for it at the counter on your next visit. Have a great day!

joins_program.description: Do they want to join   starbucks Rewards? yes, no, or maybe

interest.description: What they enjoy most: home_brewing, daily_coffee, food, or events

favorite_drink.description: Their usual drink, if they mention it

feedback.description: Any comment about the shop, in their words

home_brewing.label: Join + 15% off beans for home brewers
home_brewing.when: They brew coffee at home, buy beans, or ask about grinders or roasts.
home_brewing.sms: Hi {first_name}, it's Maya from   starbucks Coffee Co. Join   starbucks Rewards free and get 15% off your next bag of beans: {link}
home_brewing.email_subject: {first_name}, your   starbucks Rewards link (15% off beans)
home_brewing.email_body:
Hi {first_name},

Thanks for chatting with Maya today. Join   starbucks Rewards for free and get 15% off your next bag of beans:
{link}

Members earn 1 star per dollar, a free drink every 100 stars, and a birthday drink on us.

  starbucks Coffee Co.
(210) 555-0188
